description: Ghost public pages: respect origin cache policy
expression: (http.host eq "121gigawatts.org" and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] eq "authorization") and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ghost") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/members") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/p/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/private") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/account") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signup") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signout") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/unsubscribe") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/email") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/r/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sso") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.ghost") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known"))) and (http.request.uri.path.extension eq "" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/content/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/public/")) and http.request.uri.query eq "")

description: Ghost sessions, previews and APIs: bypass cache
expression: (http.host eq "121gigawatts.org" and ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ghost") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/members") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/p/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/private") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/account") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signup") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signout") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/unsubscribe") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/email") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/r/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sso") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.ghost") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known")) or not (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) or ((http.request.uri.path.extension eq "" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/content/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/public/")) and (http.cookie ne "" or any(http.request.headers.names[*] eq "authorization") or http.request.uri.query ne ""))))
